description: Checks publishing availability, remaining Personal website capacity, reset timing, hosted-image allowances, custom URL endings, branding capabilities, and inactivity policies for the connected Carryo account. Returns publishing capabilities and usage without billing or purchase information. Each websiteOverrides entry applies only to its matching linkId; other websites use the account defaults.
name: account.check_publishing

capabilities.description: Personal default capabilities. Use websiteOverrides for the named websites, not for the whole account

canCollectFormResponses.description: Whether Personal forms can currently collect responses; Team access is resolved from the website

canCustomizePasswordPage.description: Whether password pages can use custom branding in Carryo

canHideCarryoBadge.description: Whether the Carryo badge can be hidden in Carryo settings

canPublishLink.description: Whether another Personal link can be published now

canUseCustomUrlEnding.description: Whether a custom Carryo URL ending can be used

linksStayOnlineWithoutActivity.description: Whether links stay online without periodic owner activity

limits.description: Personal default policies; websiteOverrides takes precedence for the named websites

imagesPerSite.description: Default hosted-image count per Personal website; matching websiteOverrides takes precedence

inactivityWindowDays.description: Days after the owner last acts in Carryo before a link is taken offline; null when inactivity does not apply

revokedRecoveryDays.description: Default recovery period after inactivity; manual unpublishing may not be reversible. Check the website policy and Carryo settings

updatesPerLink.description: Maximum updates per link, or null for unlimited

usage.description: Personal link usage needed to answer the current action

activeLinkLimit.description: Maximum active Personal links, or null when no product limit applies

activeLinks.description: Current number of active Personal links

newLinkLimit.description: Maximum new Personal links in the current period, or null when no creation limit applies

newLinksResetAt.description: ISO-8601 time when the Personal creation allowance resets, or null when no creation limit applies

newLinksThisPeriod.description: New Personal links created or claimed in the current creation period

remainingActiveLinks.description: How many more Personal links can be published now, or null when no product limit applies

remainingNewLinks.description: New Personal links still available in the current period, or null when no creation limit applies

websiteOverrides.description: Website-specific exceptions to Personal defaults. Explicit owner-set expiry and unpublishing still apply

canHideCarryoBadge.description: Whether this website can hide its badge in Carryo settings; removal is not automatic

canUseCustomDomain.description: Whether this website can use a custom domain configured in Carryo

imagesPerSite.description: Maximum hosted images on this website; null means no plan-specific count limit

inactivityWindowDays.description: Owner-inactivity window for this website; null means no inactivity expiry

linkId.description: The website this exception applies to; never apply it to other websites

updatesPerLink.description: Update limit for this website; null means unlimited subject to fair use

title: Check Publishing Availability
